_comment: Per-env ceiling for server feature flags and Cloud Run shape. A revision may be promoted only if every flag's EFFECTIVE mode is <= the ceiling. Raising a ceiling is a reviewed PR. Allowlist uids are never stored here, only counts. Order: off < allowlist < percent < on.

rollback_floors._comment: resolve-rollback.sh refuses a last-good image built from a commit that is not at or after the floor commit (git merge-base --is-ancestor <floor> <image commit>) whenever the flag's effective mode on the rollback target is not off. The image commit comes from the 40-hex Artifact Registry tag (the github.sha IMAGE_TAG). Fail closed: no commit tag, an unreadable floor, or a commit missing from the checkout all refuse. Raising a floor is a reviewed PR, and only once the new floor is on last-good (see docs/runbooks/rollback.md).

unset_default._comment: Mode when FEATURE_<N> is unset, from backend/pkg/platform/config/config.go (graph/posts: on in dev, off in prod; all others off). check-flag-registry.sh re-derives this from config.go.
